paragraphs.text: The film was fun almost the whole way through. It was definitely silly and not quite as serious as usual, but I enjoyed it regardless.

However, towards the end it did start to drag (which was a shame because it had been pretty well-paced until that point), and I will agree that it was quite similar to other Bond films, and didn’t quite achieve its own individual identity.
However, I enjoyed it. I’m going to give it 3.5/5, which is what I planned to before I read the other reviews…
